sections.title: Instruments requiring a recall decision
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,next_due,status from instruments where site_id=$1 and status<>'retired' and (next_due is null or next_due<=current_date+30) order by next_due nulls first,code

name: calibration-record
title: Calibration evidence summary
for_each: select c.id,i.code||' '||c.performed_on::text as name from calibrations c join instruments i on i.id=c.instrument_id

sections.title: Recorded calibration result
sections.note: Evidence summary only. This is not a calibration certificate, signature, accreditation or release authorisation.
sections.sql: select i.code,i.name,c.performed_on,c.as_found,c.as_left,c.procedure_ref,c.certificate_ref,c.uncertainty_note,c.technician,c.reviewer,c.review_evidence from calibrations c join instruments i on i.id=c.instrument_id where c.id=$1

sections.title: Reference standard used
sections.sql: select r.code,r.name,r.valid_from,r.valid_until,r.certificate_ref,r.uncertainty_note from reference_standards r join calibrations c on c.standard_id=r.id where c.id=$1

name: impact-review
title: Out-of-tolerance review worksheet
for_each: select x.id,i.code as name from investigations x join calibrations c on c.id=x.calibration_id join instruments i on i.id=c.instrument_id

sections.title: Known production use
sections.sql: select code,failure_on,last_pass,batch,used_on,quantity,evidence_ref,scope from v_impact where investigation_id=$1 order by used_on
